1. Introduction
1.1 Background
Archlin is a specialty chemicals manufacturing company undertaking a Phase 1 investment in integrated Supply Management capabilities.
Archlin currently operates SAP S/4HANA as the ERP system supporting in-scope planning and transactional data.
Archlin’s current planning maturity reflects integrated planning with some automation, while continued reliance on Excel-based consolidation, manual review, and planner-driven coordination creates delays in the planning cycle.
